# Phone Use

> Give your agent a phone. One open-source CLI (phone-use) drives the
> iOS Simulator on a Mac or an Android device or emulator over adb, free and
> with no account, and gives agents the same verbs on both platforms through
> the CLI, an MCP server, and a TypeScript SDK (@phone-use/sdk). Agents read
> the screen as named elements, and every action reports whether the screen
> changed. Distinctives: deterministic map-powered navigation (goto/ask/toggle
> with zero model calls), replayable skills, an un-overridable
> destructive-action permission floor, a live browser viewer, and portable
> trace artifacts. Cloud phones, which run on our hardware, are on a waitlist:
> https://phoneuse.dev/waitlist

## Install

- CLI and MCP server (macOS or Linux): `curl -fsSL https://phoneuse.dev/install | bash` (installs Bun >= 1.3 if missing, then the CLI; re-run to update)
- With Bun >= 1.3 already installed: `npm install -g phone-use` or `bun add -g phone-use`
- SDK (Node >= 22 or Bun): `npm install @phone-use/sdk`
- Check your setup: `phone-use doctor`

## On your own machine (free, no account)

- iOS: a Mac with Xcode. `open -a Simulator`, then `phone-use observe`. If it says no simulator is booted, the Simulator is still starting: run it again in a few seconds
- Android: `phone-use connect android` with a device or emulator on adb, then `phone-use observe`
- With nothing else chosen, every verb drives the one booted simulator. Nothing is sent to phone-use's servers

## Cloud phones (waitlist)

- Cloud phones are on a waitlist: https://phoneuse.dev/waitlist
- `phone-use create ios` gives a cloud phone only to an approved account. For everyone else it creates nothing, prints how to continue on the local simulator, and exits 1 (`--json` prints `{"code":"cloud_waitlist", ...}`). When you see that message: do not retry, continue on this machine, and tell the user about the waitlist link
- For an approved account: `phone-use login`, `phone-use create ios` or `phone-use create android`, then `eval "$(phone-use env <id>)"` to attach the shell
- `phone-use list` / `phone-use close <id>` — list or close phones; 1h default lifetime (up to 24h with --ttl), closes after 15 min idle
- `phone-use install ./App.app` — install an iOS simulator build on the attached cloud phone
- Watch a cloud phone in the console at app.phoneuse.dev (live video on iOS, screenshots on Android)

## Agents

- Any MCP client: `npx -y phone-use mcp` drives the local simulator. For a cloud phone, set PHONE_USE_SANDBOX_URL and PHONE_USE_SANDBOX_TOKEN (the console prints the config)
- Claude Code: `claude mcp add --scope project phone-use -- npx -y phone-use mcp`
- Built-in agent: `phone-use task "<goal>"` (needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)
- Shell verbs: `phone-use observe | tap | type | press | scroll | wait_for | handle_alert | goto | ask | toggle | search | batch | skill | atlas`;
  `scroll down --until "<text>"` scrolls until the text is on screen, `wait_for --stable` waits until the screen stops changing;
  `--json` prints a machine-readable envelope; exit codes: 0 ok, 1 failed, 2 blocked, 3 confirmation required
